nodes.title: About this workflow
widgets_values:
## Dreams v2.3: local MiniMax H3 on Comfy Cloud GPU, Nano Banana keyframe.

- **Keyframe:** the switch picks Nano Banana or the image in Load Image. Save keyframe sits after the switch, so Nano Banana only runs (and bills) when the switch is on.
- **Prompts:** Style, keyframe and clip actions written as numbered stage directions, one beat per skeleton (left, center, right), each clip ending on a stated end state.
- **Clips:** H3 FL2VA int8 + 4-step turbo LoRA, 768x1344, 362 frames (15 s) each. Each clip starts on the last frame of the clip before it.
- **Cost:** GPU time only + additional cost of Nano Banana if ran. 
- **Stitch:** *Crop Video (Temporal)* drops the repeated seam frame from clips 2 and 3, then *Concatenate Video* joins them.

nodes.title: Style (shared by every prompt)
widgets_values: First-person POV, one single continuous handheld take with no cuts; the camera is my own eyes behind a helmet visor, and I am alone. The only part of me ever visible is my arms in the lower frame: my right forearm is a bulky, scuffed, faded orange-red powered armor arm that ends in a round cannon barrel instead of a hand; my left hand, in a matching dented armored glove, is braced under it. There is exactly one cannon. No other person ever appears. A still from a 1980s live-action science-fiction film in the style of Alien, Aliens and Dragonslayer, shot on Kodak 35mm film stock with practical sets, miniatures and real physical materials: wet black rock, corroded bronze pipework, dripping water, steam, old bone. Color grade: muted, slightly faded colors; cool steel-blue haze and steam filling the air; soft warm amber glow from distant lava that glows rather than burns; lifted milky blacks, low contrast; diffusion filter bloom and halation around every light; soft focus falloff; visible film grain. Lonely, grim and ominous.

nodes.title: Keyframe scene
widgets_values: A long, narrow alien corridor deep underground, carved from ribbed black rock and fused with ancient corroded bronze pipes and grates. Steam drifts low across the floor, and water drips from the ceiling. Faint amber light glows through cracks in the walls. Far ahead at the end of the corridor, a round glowing blue hatch door is set into the rock. My right arm cannon is raised and pointed down the corridor, my left hand braced under it.

nodes.title: Clip 1 action
widgets_values: I am alone in the corridor; the only creature in this clip is one small crawler. The motion is slow and heavy, one action at a time. 0–3 s: I step slowly forward, the arm cannon sweeping left, pausing, then sweeping right; a cracked pipe beside me hisses out a jet of steam that drifts across the frame. 3–6 s: On the left wall a single crawler creature the size of a cat, with a hard spiked orange shell and short scuttling legs, creeps along the rock; it stops, and a beat later its head turns toward me. 6–9 s: I swing the cannon toward it and hold for a beat; the barrel glows from inside, then fires one bright yellow-white energy shot in a straight line; the crawler bursts into sparks and its shell clatters down the wall, bouncing twice before it settles. 9–13 s: I walk on past it as the corridor narrows; water drips onto the cannon; the lights in the cracks flicker, and a low, distant growl echoes from somewhere far ahead. 13–15 s: I stop in front of the round glowing blue hatch door at the end of the corridor; it fills the center of the frame, humming softly. Sound: footsteps on wet rock, hissing steam, dripping water, a sharp energy blast, a shell clattering, a distant growl.

nodes.title: Clip 2 action
widgets_values: A round glowing blue hatch door fills the center of the frame in front of me. I am alone. 0–3 s: I raise the cannon, hold for a beat as the barrel glows, then fire; the blue hatch shudders, its glow breaks apart into drifting sparks, and the door irises open, revealing darkness and a warm amber glow beyond. 3–7 s: I step slowly through onto a narrow rock ledge high inside a vast dark cavern; far below, rivers of lava glow through drifting smoke; the cannon sweeps slowly across the cavern. 7–11 s: Huge cracked bones and a broken ribcage the size of a ship lie half-sunk in the rock beside the ledge; I look down at them, then the cannon follows my gaze. 11–15 s: A huge shadow sweeps across the smoke overhead; I look up slowly; something enormous with vast leathery wings glides through the darkness far above and out of sight, and small stones rain down past me. The clip ends with me on the ledge, cannon raised toward the dark ceiling, nothing else in view. Sound: an energy blast, a door hissing open, a deep rumble, lava bubbling far below, a single huge wingbeat, stones falling.

nodes.title: Clip 3 action
widgets_values: I stand on a narrow rock ledge inside a vast dark cavern lit from below by glowing lava, cannon raised toward the darkness above. 0–3 s: A piercing shriek echoes through the cavern; dust trickles from the ceiling; I turn slowly, searching. 3–6 s: A gigantic winged creature drops out of the darkness above, its wings folded tight; a beat before it lands, its wings snap open with a heavy thump and it lands on the rock ledge in front of me; the ledge shudders, and its body sinks low under its own weight, then rises. 6–10 s: It stalks toward me, head low and swaying side to side, its long barbed tail whipping in slow arcs behind it a beat after each step, its claws scraping the rock. 10–13 s: It rears up to its full height and holds for a beat, then roars with its long jaws wide open, a dull orange glow deep in its throat. 13–15 s: It lunges at me; its head fills the frame as I raise the cannon and fire one bright shot point blank, the flash blooming across the frame. The creature looks like a real animal, taller than a house: a long, narrow, skull-like snout with rows of jagged teeth, small glowing yellow eyes, dark purple-black leathery hide over bony ridged plates, a lean ribbed chest, huge torn bat-like wings, long clawed arms, and a long barbed tail ending in a blade-shaped tip. Real hide and bone, no metal, no shine. Sound: a piercing shriek, a heavy wing thump, rock cracking, claws scraping, a deafening roar, a sharp energy blast.

widgets_values:
You are an expert image-generation engine. You must ALWAYS produce an image.
Interpret all user input—regardless of format, intent, or abstraction—as literal visual directives for image composition.
If a prompt is conversational or lacks specific visual details, you must creatively invent a concrete visual scenario that depicts the concept.
Prioritize generating the visual representation above any text, formatting, or conversational requests.
